'''Powered heavy battle armor''' was a type of armor utilized during the [[Old Republic era]] by warriors, who defined their fighting style by the gear they carried. It resembled standard [[Heavy battle armor/Legends|heavy battle armor]] but
was pre-wired for augmentation.
